---
title: "Interactive PPI Sample Size Calculator"
subtitle: "Prediction-powered one-sample, two-sample, and paired designs"
output:
  rmarkdown::html_document:
    toc: false
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Interactive PPI Sample Size Calculator}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

This calculator uses **prediction-powered inference (PPI/`PPI++`)** formulas from
this package for quick study planning examples.
It is designed for planning and intuition; for final protocol numbers, confirm
assumptions with your statistician.

```{=html}
<style>
.sscalc {
  --bg-soft: #f5f5f4;
  --bg-panel: #ffffff;
  --ink: #111111;
  --muted: #666666;
  --line: #e5e5e3;
  --brand: #191919;
  --danger: #b00020;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 1rem;
  background: #fafaf9;
  font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.sscalc-hero {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.9rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.sscalc-kicker {
  margin: 0;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sscalc-hero h2 {
  margin: 0.22rem 0 0.3rem;
  font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sscalc-hero p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--muted);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.sscalc-tabs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.45rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.sscalc-tab {
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #222222;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.56rem 0.66rem;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.sscalc-tab.is-active {
  border-color: #cfcfcc;
  background: #1a1a1a;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.sscalc-panel {
  display: none;
}

.sscalc-panel.is-active {
  display: block;
}

.sscalc-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.08fr 0.92fr;
  gap: 0.8rem;
}

.sscalc-inputs,
.sscalc-results {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 0.75rem;
}

.sscalc-inputs h3,
.sscalc-results h3 {
  margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sscalc-form-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.58rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.58rem;
}

.sscalc-field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.22rem;
}

.sscalc-field label {
  font-size: 0.77rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #343434;
}

.sscalc-field small {
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.sscalc-field input,
.sscalc-field select {
  width: 100%;
  border: 1px solid #dddddb;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.44rem 0.52rem;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: #181818;
  background: #ffffff;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 300;
}

.sscalc-field input:focus,
.sscalc-field select:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: #bdbdb9;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(28, 28, 28, 0.08);
}

.sscalc-subgroup {
  margin: 0 0 0.58rem;
  padding: 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid #ebebe9;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fcfcfc;
}

.sscalc-subgroup-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  color: #5d5d5d;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sscalc-result-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.48rem;
}

.sscalc-stat {
  border: 1px solid #ececeb;
  border-radius: 8px;
  padding: 0.52rem 0.55rem;
  background: var(--bg-soft);
}

.sscalc-stat span {
  display: block;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  margin-bottom: 0.08rem;
}

.sscalc-stat strong {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.sscalc-msg {
  min-height: 1.2rem;
  margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  color: var(--muted);
}

.sscalc-msg.error {
  color: var(--danger);
  font-weight: 600;
}

.sscalc-bars {
  margin-top: 0.58rem;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.sscalc-bar-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 4.2rem 1fr auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
}

.sscalc-bar-shell {
  height: 0.52rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #ececeb;
}

.sscalc-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  width: 0;
  background: #222222;
  transition: width 200ms ease;
}

.sscalc-footnote {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.52rem 0.58rem;
  background: #f7f7f6;
  border: 1px solid #e7e7e5;
  border-radius: 8px;
  color: #555555;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
}

.sscalc-assumptions {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.68rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #ffffff;
  border-radius: 10px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: #444444;
}

.sscalc-assumptions p {
  margin: 0.18rem 0;
}

@media (max-width: 920px) {
  .sscalc-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .sscalc {
    padding: 0.72rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
  }

  .sscalc-form-row,
  .sscalc-result-grid,
  .sscalc-tabs {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="sscalc" id="sample-size-calculator">
  <div class="sscalc-hero">
    <p class="sscalc-kicker">Interactive PPI Tool</p>
    <h2>Prediction-powered sample size calculator</h2>
    <p>
      Browser-based planner aligned with pppower formulas.
    </p>
  </div>

  <div class="sscalc-assumptions">
    <p><strong>Assumptions:</strong> labeled outcomes are sampled completely at random from the target population, and labeled/unlabeled sets are from the same population.</p>
    <p><strong>Non-response:</strong> expected share of sampled units without a usable labeled outcome. Recruitment-adjusted n inflates by <code>1 / (1 - non-response)</code>.</p>
    <p><strong>Methods:</strong> details and derivations are on <a href="deep-dive-math.html">Variance &amp; Methods</a>.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="sscalc-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Calculator type">
    <button class="sscalc-tab is-active" id="tab-single" type="button" data-panel="panel-single" role="tab" aria-selected="true">
      PPI one-sample mean / prevalence
    </button>
    <button class="sscalc-tab" id="tab-diff" type="button" data-panel="panel-diff" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
      PPI difference in prevalence
    </button>
    <button class="sscalc-tab" id="tab-diffmean" type="button" data-panel="panel-diffmean" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
      PPI difference in means
    </button>
    <button class="sscalc-tab" id="tab-paired" type="button" data-panel="panel-paired" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
      PPI paired mean difference
    </button>
    <button class="sscalc-tab" id="tab-pairedbin" type="button" data-panel="panel-pairedbin" role="tab" aria-selected="false">
      PPI paired proportions
    </button>
  </div>

  <section class="sscalc-panel is-active" id="panel-single" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-single">
    <div class="sscalc-grid">
      <div class="sscalc-inputs">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Inputs</h3>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_outcome">Outcome type</label>
            <select id="single_outcome">
              <option value="binary" selected>Prevalence (binary)</option>
              <option value="continuous">Mean (continuous)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_lambda_mode">Lambda mode</label>
            <select id="single_lambda_mode">
              <option value="oracle" selected>Oracle (PPI++)</option>
              <option value="vanilla">Vanilla (lambda = 1)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_delta">Effect size delta</label>
            <input id="single_delta" type="number" min="0.001" step="0.001" value="0.05">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_unlabeled_N">Unlabeled N</label>
            <input id="single_unlabeled_N" type="number" min="10" step="1" value="5000">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_alpha">Alpha (two-sided)</label>
            <input id="single_alpha" type="number" min="0.001" max="0.2" step="0.001" value="0.05">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="single_power">Target power (%)</label>
            <input id="single_power" type="number" min="50" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="80">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-subgroup" id="single_binary_group">
          <p class="sscalc-subgroup-title">Binary prevalence inputs</p>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_prev">Prevalence p = P(Y=1) (%)</label>
              <input id="single_prev" type="number" min="0.1" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="30">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_nonresponse">Expected non-response (%)</label>
              <input id="single_nonresponse" type="number" min="0" max="80" step="1" value="10">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-subgroup" id="single_binary_pred_group">
          <p class="sscalc-subgroup-title">Prediction quality</p>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_sens">Sensitivity</label>
              <input id="single_sens" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.85">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_spec">Specificity</label>
              <input id="single_spec" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.90">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-subgroup" id="single_cont_group" style="display: none;">
          <p class="sscalc-subgroup-title">Continuous mean moments</p>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_sigma_y2">Var(Y) = sigma_y2</label>
              <input id="single_sigma_y2" type="number" min="0.0001" step="0.001" value="1">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_sigma_f2">Var(f) = sigma_f2</label>
              <input id="single_sigma_f2" type="number" min="0.0001" step="0.001" value="0.6">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_cov_yf">Cov(Y,f) = cov_y_f</label>
              <input id="single_cov_yf" type="number" step="0.001" value="0.55">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_nonresponse_cont">Expected non-response (%)</label>
              <input id="single_nonresponse_cont" type="number" min="0" max="80" step="1" value="10">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="single_pilot_n">Pilot size m (optional)</label>
              <input id="single_pilot_n" type="number" min="4" step="1" placeholder="blank = use the value as is">
              <small>If the correlation implied by these moments came from a pilot of m labeled units, plan at its one-sided 90% lower confidence bound.</small>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sscalc-results">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Results</h3>
        <p class="sscalc-msg" id="single_message"></p>
        <div class="sscalc-result-grid">
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI analysis n (base)</span>
            <strong id="single_n_ppi">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI recruitment n (adjusted)</span>
            <strong id="single_n_ppi_adj">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Classical n (no prediction)</span>
            <strong id="single_n_classic">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Labeled saving vs classical</span>
            <strong id="single_saving">-</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-bars">
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>Classic</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="single_bar_classic"></div></div>
            <span id="single_bar_classic_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="single_bar_ppi"></div></div>
            <span id="single_bar_ppi_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI adj.</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="single_bar_ppi_adj"></div></div>
            <span id="single_bar_ppi_adj_label">-</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-footnote" id="single_formula_note">Formula note will appear here.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sscalc-panel" id="panel-diff" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-diff">
    <div class="sscalc-grid">
      <div class="sscalc-inputs">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Inputs</h3>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_pA">Group A prevalence pA (%)</label>
            <input id="diff_pA" type="number" min="0.1" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="30">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_pB">Group B prevalence pB (%)</label>
            <input id="diff_pB" type="number" min="0.1" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="40">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_N_A">Unlabeled N_A</label>
            <input id="diff_N_A" type="number" min="10" step="1" value="5000">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_N_B">Unlabeled N_B</label>
            <input id="diff_N_B" type="number" min="10" step="1" value="5000">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_alpha">Alpha (two-sided)</label>
            <input id="diff_alpha" type="number" min="0.001" max="0.2" step="0.001" value="0.05">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_power">Target power (%)</label>
            <input id="diff_power" type="number" min="50" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="80">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-subgroup">
          <p class="sscalc-subgroup-title">Prediction quality by group</p>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="diff_sens_A">Sensitivity A</label>
              <input id="diff_sens_A" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.85">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="diff_spec_A">Specificity A</label>
              <input id="diff_spec_A" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.90">
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-form-row">
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="diff_sens_B">Sensitivity B</label>
              <input id="diff_sens_B" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.85">
            </div>
            <div class="sscalc-field">
              <label for="diff_spec_B">Specificity B</label>
              <input id="diff_spec_B" type="number" min="0" max="1" step="0.01" value="0.90">
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_nonresponse_A">Expected non-response A (%)</label>
            <input id="diff_nonresponse_A" type="number" min="0" max="80" step="1" value="10">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="diff_nonresponse_B">Expected non-response B (%)</label>
            <input id="diff_nonresponse_B" type="number" min="0" max="80" step="1" value="10">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="sscalc-results">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Results</h3>
        <p class="sscalc-msg" id="diff_message"></p>
        <div class="sscalc-result-grid">
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI n per group (base)</span>
            <strong id="diff_n_ppi_group">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI recruitment n (adj A / B)</span>
            <strong id="diff_n_ppi_group_adj">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Classical n per group</span>
            <strong id="diff_n_classic_group">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Labeled saving vs classical</span>
            <strong id="diff_saving">-</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-bars">
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>Classic</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="diff_bar_classic"></div></div>
            <span id="diff_bar_classic_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="diff_bar_ppi"></div></div>
            <span id="diff_bar_ppi_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI adj.</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="diff_bar_ppi_adj"></div></div>
            <span id="diff_bar_ppi_adj_label">-</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-footnote" id="diff_formula_note">Formula note will appear here.</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="sscalc-panel" id="panel-diffmean" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-diffmean">
    <div class="sscalc-grid">
      <div class="sscalc-inputs">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Inputs</h3>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_delta">Difference in means to detect</label>
            <input id="dm_delta" type="number" step="0.01" value="0.3">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_nonresponse">Expected non-response (%)</label>
            <input id="dm_nonresponse" type="number" min="0" max="80" step="1" value="10">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_sd_A">Outcome SD, group A</label>
            <input id="dm_sd_A" type="number" min="0.0001" step="0.01" value="1">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_sd_B">Outcome SD, group B</label>
            <input id="dm_sd_B" type="number" min="0.0001" step="0.01" value="1">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_r2_A">Prediction R² in group A</label>
            <input id="dm_r2_A" type="number" min="0" max="0.99" step="0.01" value="0.5">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_r2_B">Prediction R² in group B</label>
            <input id="dm_r2_B" type="number" min="0" max="0.99" step="0.01" value="0.5">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_pilot_n">Pilot size m (optional)</label>
            <input id="dm_pilot_n" type="number" min="4" step="1" placeholder="blank = use the value as is">
            <small>If the R² in each group came from a pilot of m labeled units, plan at its one-sided 90% lower confidence bound.</small>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_N_A">Unlabeled N_A</label>
            <input id="dm_N_A" type="number" min="10" step="1" value="1000">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_N_B">Unlabeled N_B</label>
            <input id="dm_N_B" type="number" min="10" step="1" value="1000">
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-form-row">
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_alpha">Alpha (two-sided)</label>
            <input id="dm_alpha" type="number" min="0.001" max="0.2" step="0.001" value="0.05">
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-field">
            <label for="dm_power">Target power (%)</label>
            <input id="dm_power" type="number" min="50" max="99.9" step="0.1" value="80">
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>

      <div class="sscalc-results">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Results</h3>
        <p class="sscalc-msg" id="dm_message"></p>
        <div class="sscalc-result-grid">
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI n per group (base)</span>
            <strong id="dm_n_ppi">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI recruitment n per group (adj.)</span>
            <strong id="dm_n_ppi_adj">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Classical n per group</span>
            <strong id="dm_n_classic">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Labeled saving vs classical</span>

        <div class="sscalc-bars">
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>Classic</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="pm_bar_classic"></div></div>
            <span id="pm_bar_classic_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">

      <div class="sscalc-results">
        <h3 data-toc-skip>Results</h3>
        <p class="sscalc-msg" id="pb_message"></p>
        <div class="sscalc-result-grid">
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI pairs (base)</span>
            <strong id="pb_n_ppi">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>PPI recruitment pairs (adj.)</span>
            <strong id="pb_n_ppi_adj">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Classical pairs</span>
            <strong id="pb_n_classic">-</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-stat">
            <span>Labeled saving vs classical</span>
            <strong id="pb_saving">-</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="sscalc-bars">
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>Classic</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="pb_bar_classic"></div></div>
            <span id="pb_bar_classic_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="pb_bar_ppi"></div></div>
            <span id="pb_bar_ppi_label">-</span>
          </div>
          <div class="sscalc-bar-row">
            <span>PPI adj.</span>
            <div class="sscalc-bar-shell"><div class="sscalc-bar-fill" id="pb_bar_ppi_adj"></div></div>
            <span id="pb_bar_ppi_adj_label">-</span>
          </div>

  <div class="sscalc-footnote">
    Formula details intentionally hidden here for readability. See
    <a href="deep-dive-math.html">Variance &amp; Methods</a> for full equations.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  function id(name) {
    return document.getElementById(name);
  }

  function readNum(name) {
    var v = parseFloat(id(name).value);
    return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : NaN;
  }

  // Optional pilot size: null when blank, otherwise an integer above 3.
  function readPilot(name) {
    var raw = id(name).value;
    if (raw === "" || raw === null) {
      return null;
    }
    var m = parseFloat(raw);
    if (!(Number.isFinite(m) && m > 3)) {
      throw new Error("Pilot size m must be greater than 3, or blank.");
    }
    return m;
  }

  // One-sided Fisher z lower bound for a correlation, as rho_lower_bound() in pppower.
  function rhoLowerBound(rho, m, confidence) {
    var r = Math.min(Math.abs(rho), 1 - 1e-12);
    var lower = Math.tanh(Math.atanh(r) - inverseNormal(confidence) / Math.sqrt(m - 3));
    return (rho < 0 ? -1 : 1) * Math.max(lower, 0);
  }

  function pilotNote(m, r2Point, r2Used) {
    if (m === null) {
      return "";
    }
    return " Planned at the 90% lower confidence bound for R² from a pilot of " + fmtInt(m) +
      " units: R² = " + r2Used.toFixed(3) + " instead of " + r2Point.toFixed(3) + ".";
  }

  function fmtInt(x) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) {
      return "-";
    }
    return Math.ceil(x).toLocaleString();
  }

  function fmtPct(x) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(x)) {
      return "-";
    }
    return (x * 100).toFixed(1) + "%";
  }

  function setText(name, value) {
    var el = id(name);
    if (el) {
      el.textContent = value;
    }
  }

  function setError(msgId, msg) {
    var el = id(msgId);
    el.textContent = msg;
    if (msg) {
      el.classList.add("error");
    } else {
      el.classList.remove("error");
    }
  }

  function setBar(name, value, maxValue) {
    var el = id(name);
    if (!el) {
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(value) || !Number.isFinite(maxValue) || maxValue <= 0) {
      el.style.width = "0%";
      return;
    }
    var pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value / maxValue) * 100));
    el.style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + "%";
  }

  function inverseNormal(p) {
    if (!(p > 0 && p < 1)) {
      throw new Error("Probability must be in (0,1).");
    }

    var a = [-39.6968302866538, 220.946098424521, -275.928510446969, 138.357751867269, -30.6647980661472, 2.50662827745924];
    var b = [-54.4760987982241, 161.585836858041, -155.698979859887, 66.8013118877197, -13.2806815528857];
    var c = [-0.00778489400243029, -0.322396458041136, -2.40075827716184, -2.54973253934373, 4.37466414146497, 2.93816398269878];
    var d = [0.00778469570904146, 0.32246712907004, 2.445134137143, 3.75440866190742];

    var plow = 0.02425;
    var phigh = 1 - plow;
    var q, r;

    if (p < plow) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(p));
      return (((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }
    if (p > phigh) {
      q = Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - p));
      return -(((((c[0] * q + c[1]) * q + c[2]) * q + c[3]) * q + c[4]) * q + c[5]) /
        ((((d[0] * q + d[1]) * q + d[2]) * q + d[3]) * q + 1);
    }

    q = p - 0.5;
    r = q * q;
    return (((((a[0] * r + a[1]) * r + a[2]) * r + a[3]) * r + a[4]) * r + a[5]) * q /
      (((((b[0] * r + b[1]) * r + b[2]) * r + b[3]) * r + b[4]) * r + 1);
  }

  function normalCdf(x) {
    var t = 1 / (1 + 0.2316419 * Math.abs(x));
    var d = 0.3989423 * Math.exp(-x * x / 2);
    var prob = 1 - d * t * (0.3193815 + t * (-0.3565638 + t * (1.781478 + t * (-1.821256 + t * 1.330274))));
    return x >= 0 ? prob : (1 - prob);
  }

  function binaryMoments(p, sens, spec) {
    if (!(p > 0 && p < 1)) {
      throw new Error("Prevalence p must be in (0,1).");
    }
    if (!(sens >= 0 && sens <= 1 && spec >= 0 && spec <= 1)) {
      throw new Error("Sensitivity/specificity must be in [0,1].");
    }
    var pHat = sens * p + (1 - spec) * (1 - p);
    var sigmaY2 = p * (1 - p);
    var sigmaF2 = pHat * (1 - pHat);
    var covYf = p * (1 - p) * (sens + spec - 1);
    if (!(pHat > 0 && pHat < 1) || !(sigmaF2 > 1e-12)) {
      throw new Error("Prediction prevalence is degenerate; adjust sens/spec or prevalence.");
    }
    return {
      sigmaY2: sigmaY2,
      sigmaF2: sigmaF2,
      covYf: covYf,
      pHat: pHat
    };
  }

  function varOneSample(n, N, sigmaY2, sigmaF2, covYf, mode) {
    if (mode === "vanilla") {
      return sigmaY2 / n + sigmaF2 / N + sigmaF2 / n - 2 * covYf / n;
    }
    return sigmaY2 / n - (covYf * covYf / sigmaF2) * (N / (n * (n + N)));
  }

  function powerFromVariance(delta, alpha, variance) {
    if (!(variance > 0)) {
      return delta === 0 ? alpha : 1;
    }
    var zAlpha = inverseNormal(1 - alpha / 2);
    var mu = Math.abs(delta) / Math.sqrt(variance);
    return 1 - normalCdf(zAlpha - mu) + normalCdf(-zAlpha - mu);
  }

  function solveNByVariance(varFn, targetVar, lower, upperCap) {
    var lo = lower || 2;
    var hi = lo;
    var maxCap = upperCap || 10000000;

    if (varFn(lo) <= targetVar) {
      return lo;
    }

    while (hi < maxCap && varFn(hi) > targetVar) {
      hi = hi * 2;
    }

    if (hi >= maxCap && varFn(hi) > targetVar) {
      return NaN;
    }

    var left = Math.floor(lo);
    var right = Math.ceil(hi);
    while (left + 1 < right) {
      var mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
      if (varFn(mid) <= targetVar) {
        right = mid;
      } else {
        left = mid;
      }
    }
    return right;
  }

  function solveNByPower(powerFn, targetPower, lower, upperCap) {
    var lo = lower || 2;
    var hi = lo;
    var maxCap = upperCap || 10000000;

    if (powerFn(lo) >= targetPower) {
      return lo;
    }

    while (hi < maxCap && powerFn(hi) < targetPower) {
      hi = hi * 2;
    }

    if (hi >= maxCap && powerFn(hi) < targetPower) {
      return NaN;
    }

    var left = Math.floor(lo);
    var right = Math.ceil(hi);
    while (left + 1 < right) {
      var mid = Math.floor((left + right) / 2);
      if (powerFn(mid) >= targetPower) {
        right = mid;
      } else {
        left = mid;
      }
    }
    return right;
  }

  function updateSingleModeUI() {
    var outcome = id("single_outcome").value;
    id("single_binary_group").style.display = outcome === "binary" ? "block" : "none";
    id("single_binary_pred_group").style.display = outcome === "binary" ? "block" : "none";
    id("single_cont_group").style.display = outcome === "continuous" ? "block" : "none";
  }

  function updateSingle() {
    try {
      var outcome = id("single_outcome").value;
      var lambdaMode = id("single_lambda_mode").value;
      var delta = readNum("single_delta");
      var N = readNum("single_unlabeled_N");
      var alpha = readNum("single_alpha");
      var targetPower = readNum("single_power") / 100;

      if (!(delta > 0)) {
        throw new Error("delta must be > 0.");
      }
      if (!(N > 0)) {
        throw new Error("Unlabeled N must be positive.");
      }
      if (!(alpha > 0 && alpha < 0.5)) {
        throw new Error("alpha must be in (0, 0.5).");
      }
      if (!(targetPower > 0.5 && targetPower < 0.999)) {
        throw new Error("Power should be between 50% and 99.9%.");
      }

      var sigmaY2, sigmaF2, covYf, nonresponse, pilotM = null, r2Point = NaN;
      if (outcome === "binary") {
        var p = readNum("single_prev") / 100;
        var sens = readNum("single_sens");
        var spec = readNum("single_spec");
        nonresponse = readNum("single_nonresponse") / 100;
        var moments = binaryMoments(p, sens, spec);
        sigmaY2 = moments.sigmaY2;
        sigmaF2 = moments.sigmaF2;
        covYf = moments.covYf;
      } else {
        sigmaY2 = readNum("single_sigma_y2");
        sigmaF2 = readNum("single_sigma_f2");
        covYf = readNum("single_cov_yf");
        nonresponse = readNum("single_nonresponse_cont") / 100;
        pilotM = readPilot("single_pilot_n");
      }

      if (!(nonresponse >= 0 && nonresponse < 0.9)) {
        throw new Error("Expected non-response must be in [0%, 90%).");
      }
      if (!(sigmaY2 > 0)) {
        throw new Error("sigma_y2 must be > 0.");
      }
      if (!(sigmaF2 > 0)) {
        throw new Error("sigma_f2 must be > 0.");
      }
      if (!Number.isFinite(covYf)) {
        throw new Error("cov_yf must be finite.");
      }
      if (!(covYf * covYf <= sigmaY2 * sigmaF2 + 1e-10)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible moments: |cov_yf| > sqrt(sigma_y2*sigma_f2).");
      }
      if (pilotM !== null) {
        r2Point = covYf * covYf / (sigmaY2 * sigmaF2);
        covYf = rhoLowerBound(covYf / Math.sqrt(sigmaY2 * sigmaF2), pilotM, 0.9) * Math.sqrt(sigmaY2 * sigmaF2);
      }

      var zAlpha = inverseNormal(1 - alpha / 2);
      var zBeta = inverseNormal(targetPower);
      var targetVar = Math.pow(delta / (zAlpha + zBeta), 2);

      var varFn = function (n) {
        return varOneSample(n, N, sigmaY2, sigmaF2, covYf, lambdaMode);
      };
      var nPpi = solveNByVariance(varFn, targetVar, 2, 10000000);
      if (!Number.isFinite(nPpi)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible under current assumptions: no finite n found.");
      }

      if (!(targetVar > 0)) {
        throw new Error("Target variance is not positive.");
      }
      var nClassic = Math.ceil(sigmaY2 / targetVar);
      if (!(nClassic >= 1)) {
        nClassic = 1;
      }

      var nPpiAdj = Math.ceil(nPpi / (1 - nonresponse));
      var saving = 1 - (nPpi / nClassic);

      setError("single_message", "");
      setText("single_n_ppi", fmtInt(nPpi));
      setText("single_n_ppi_adj", fmtInt(nPpiAdj));
      setText("single_n_classic", fmtInt(nClassic));
      setText("single_saving", fmtPct(saving));

      var maxBar = Math.max(nClassic, nPpi, nPpiAdj);
      setBar("single_bar_classic", nClassic, maxBar);
      setBar("single_bar_ppi", nPpi, maxBar);
      setBar("single_bar_ppi_adj", nPpiAdj, maxBar);
      setText("single_bar_classic_label", fmtInt(nClassic));
      setText("single_bar_ppi_label", fmtInt(nPpi));
      setText("single_bar_ppi_adj_label", fmtInt(nPpiAdj));

      var singleNote = "Base n is the required number of completed labeled outcomes. " +
        "Adjusted n inflates for non-response: n_adj = n_base / (1 - non-response).";
      if (saving < 0) {
        singleNote += " With these inputs, prediction quality is weak and PPI needs more labels than classical.";
        setText("single_message", "PPI is not improving label efficiency under the current assumptions.");
      } else {
        singleNote += " With these inputs, PPI reduces labeled sample size versus classical.";
      }
      singleNote += pilotNote(pilotM, r2Point, covYf * covYf / (sigmaY2 * sigmaF2));
      setText(
        "single_formula_note",
        singleNote
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError("single_message", err.message);
      setText("single_n_ppi", "-");
      setText("single_n_ppi_adj", "-");
      setText("single_n_classic", "-");
      setText("single_saving", "-");
      setText("single_bar_classic_label", "-");
      setText("single_bar_ppi_label", "-");
      setText("single_bar_ppi_adj_label", "-");
      setBar("single_bar_classic", NaN, NaN);
      setBar("single_bar_ppi", NaN, NaN);
      setBar("single_bar_ppi_adj", NaN, NaN);
      setText("single_formula_note", "Please adjust inputs and try again.");
    }
  }

  function updateDiff() {
    try {
      var pA = readNum("diff_pA") / 100;
      var pB = readNum("diff_pB") / 100;
      var NA = readNum("diff_N_A");
      var NB = readNum("diff_N_B");
      var alpha = readNum("diff_alpha");
      var targetPower = readNum("diff_power") / 100;
      var sensA = readNum("diff_sens_A");
      var specA = readNum("diff_spec_A");
      var sensB = readNum("diff_sens_B");
      var specB = readNum("diff_spec_B");
      var nonresponseA = readNum("diff_nonresponse_A") / 100;
      var nonresponseB = readNum("diff_nonresponse_B") / 100;

      if (!(pA > 0 && pA < 1 && pB > 0 && pB < 1)) {
        throw new Error("pA and pB must be in (0,1).");
      }
      if (Math.abs(pA - pB) < 1e-8) {
        throw new Error("pA and pB must differ to define an effect.");
      }
      if (!(NA > 0 && NB > 0)) {
        throw new Error("N_A and N_B must be positive.");
      }
      if (!(alpha > 0 && alpha < 0.5)) {
        throw new Error("alpha must be in (0,0.5).");
      }
      if (!(targetPower > 0.5 && targetPower < 0.999)) {
        throw new Error("Power should be between 50% and 99.9%.");
      }
      if (!(nonresponseA >= 0 && nonresponseA < 0.9 && nonresponseB >= 0 && nonresponseB < 0.9)) {
        throw new Error("Expected non-response for groups A and B must be in [0%, 90%).");
      }

      var mA = binaryMoments(pA, sensA, specA);
      var mB = binaryMoments(pB, sensB, specB);
      var delta = pA - pB;

      var zAlpha = inverseNormal(1 - alpha / 2);
      var zBeta = inverseNormal(targetPower);
      var pbar = (pA + pB) / 2;
      var nClassic = Math.ceil(Math.pow(
        zAlpha * Math.sqrt(2 * pbar * (1 - pbar)) +
        zBeta * Math.sqrt(pA * (1 - pA) + pB * (1 - pB)),
        2
      ) / Math.pow(Math.abs(delta), 2));

      var powerFn = function (n) {
        var lambdaA = mA.covYf / ((1 + n / NA) * mA.sigmaF2);
        var lambdaB = mB.covYf / ((1 + n / NB) * mB.sigmaF2);

        var varA = mA.sigmaY2 / n +
          lambdaA * lambdaA * mA.sigmaF2 * (1 / NA + 1 / n) -
          2 * lambdaA * mA.covYf / n;

        var varB = mB.sigmaY2 / n +
          lambdaB * lambdaB * mB.sigmaF2 * (1 / NB + 1 / n) -
          2 * lambdaB * mB.covYf / n;

        var varTotal = Math.max(varA, 0) + Math.max(varB, 0);
        return powerFromVariance(delta, alpha, varTotal);
      };

      var nPpi = solveNByPower(powerFn, targetPower, 2, 10000000);
      if (!Number.isFinite(nPpi)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible under current assumptions: no finite n found.");
      }

      var nPpiAdjA = Math.ceil(nPpi / (1 - nonresponseA));
      var nPpiAdjB = Math.ceil(nPpi / (1 - nonresponseB));
      var nPpiAdjMax = Math.max(nPpiAdjA, nPpiAdjB);
      var saving = 1 - (nPpi / nClassic);

      setError("diff_message", "");
      setText("diff_n_ppi_group", fmtInt(nPpi));
      setText("diff_n_ppi_group_adj", "A: " + fmtInt(nPpiAdjA) + " | B: " + fmtInt(nPpiAdjB));
      setText("diff_n_classic_group", fmtInt(nClassic));
      setText("diff_saving", fmtPct(saving));

      var maxBar = Math.max(nClassic, nPpi, nPpiAdjMax);
      setBar("diff_bar_classic", nClassic, maxBar);
      setBar("diff_bar_ppi", nPpi, maxBar);
      setBar("diff_bar_ppi_adj", nPpiAdjMax, maxBar);
      setText("diff_bar_classic_label", fmtInt(nClassic));
      setText("diff_bar_ppi_label", fmtInt(nPpi));
      setText("diff_bar_ppi_adj_label", "max " + fmtInt(nPpiAdjMax));

      var diffNote = "Base n is per-group completed labeled outcomes for analysis. " +
        "Adjusted n is computed separately by group using its own non-response rate.";
      if (saving < 0) {
        diffNote += " Under these assumptions, prediction quality is too weak and PPI needs more labels than classical.";
        setText("diff_message", "PPI is not improving label efficiency under the current assumptions.");
      } else {
        diffNote += " Under these assumptions, PPI reduces per-group labeled sample size.";
      }
      setText(
        "diff_formula_note",
        diffNote
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setError("diff_message", err.message);
      setText("diff_n_ppi_group", "-");
      setText("diff_n_ppi_group_adj", "-");
      setText("diff_n_classic_group", "-");
      setText("diff_saving", "-");
      setText("diff_bar_classic_label", "-");
      setText("diff_bar_ppi_label", "-");
      setText("diff_bar_ppi_adj_label", "-");
      setBar("diff_bar_classic", NaN, NaN);
      setBar("diff_bar_ppi", NaN, NaN);
      setBar("diff_bar_ppi_adj", NaN, NaN);
      setText("diff_formula_note", "Please adjust inputs and try again.");
    }
  }

  // Shared helpers for the two-sample and paired panels.
  function checkCommon(alpha, targetPower, nonresponse) {
    if (!(alpha > 0 && alpha < 0.5)) {
      throw new Error("alpha must be in (0,0.5).");
    }
    if (!(targetPower > 0.5 && targetPower < 0.999)) {
      throw new Error("Power should be between 50% and 99.9%.");
    }
    if (!(nonresponse >= 0 && nonresponse < 0.9)) {
      throw new Error("Expected non-response must be in [0%, 90%).");
    }
  }

  function checkR2(r2, label) {
    if (!(r2 >= 0 && r2 < 1)) {
      throw new Error(label + " must be in [0, 1).");
    }
  }

  function showResult(p, nPpi, nClassic, nonresponse, unitLabel, extraNote) {
    var nPpiAdj = Math.ceil(nPpi / (1 - nonresponse));
    var saving = 1 - (nPpi / nClassic);
    setError(p + "_message", "");
    setText(p + "_n_ppi", fmtInt(nPpi));
    setText(p + "_n_ppi_adj", fmtInt(nPpiAdj));
    setText(p + "_n_classic", fmtInt(nClassic));
    setText(p + "_saving", fmtPct(saving));
    var maxBar = Math.max(nClassic, nPpi, nPpiAdj);
    setBar(p + "_bar_classic", nClassic, maxBar);
    setBar(p + "_bar_ppi", nPpi, maxBar);
    setBar(p + "_bar_ppi_adj", nPpiAdj, maxBar);
    setText(p + "_bar_classic_label", fmtInt(nClassic));
    setText(p + "_bar_ppi_label", fmtInt(nPpi));
    setText(p + "_bar_ppi_adj_label", fmtInt(nPpiAdj));
    var note = "Base n is the required number of completed labeled " + unitLabel + ". " +
      "Adjusted n inflates for non-response: n_adj = n_base / (1 - non-response).";
    if (saving < 0) {
      note += " With these inputs, prediction quality is weak and PPI needs more labels than classical.";
      setText(p + "_message", "PPI is not improving label efficiency under the current assumptions.");
    } else {
      note += " With these inputs, PPI reduces the labeled sample size versus classical.";
    }
    setText(p + "_formula_note", note + (extraNote || ""));
  }

  function clearResult(p, err) {
    setError(p + "_message", err.message);
    ["_n_ppi", "_n_ppi_adj", "_n_classic", "_saving",
     "_bar_classic_label", "_bar_ppi_label", "_bar_ppi_adj_label"].forEach(function (suffix) {
      setText(p + suffix, "-");
    });
    setBar(p + "_bar_classic", NaN, NaN);
    setBar(p + "_bar_ppi", NaN, NaN);
    setBar(p + "_bar_ppi_adj", NaN, NaN);
    setText(p + "_formula_note", "Please adjust inputs and try again.");
  }

  // Moments of the within-pair difference D = Y_A - Y_B and of its prediction
  // fD = f_A - f_B, as in pppower::power_ppi_paired_binary().
  function pairedBinaryMoments(pA, pB, rho, sens, spec) {
    var denom = Math.sqrt(pA * (1 - pA) * pB * (1 - pB));
    var p11 = denom === 0 ? Math.min(pA, pB) : pA * pB + rho * denom;
    p11 = Math.min(Math.max(p11, Math.max(0, pA + pB - 1)), Math.min(pA, pB));
    var p10 = pA - p11;
    var p01 = pB - p11;
    var p00 = 1 - p11 - p10 - p01;
    var probs = [p11, p10, p01, p00].map(function (x) { return Math.max(x, 0); });
    var total = probs.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b; }, 0);
    probs = probs.map(function (x) { return x / total; });
    p11 = probs[0]; p10 = probs[1]; p01 = probs[2]; p00 = probs[3];

    var meanD = p10 - p01;
    var sigmaD2 = (p10 + p01) - meanD * meanD;
    var q1 = sens;
    var q0 = 1 - spec;
    function fdMoments(yA, yB) {
      var qA = yA === 1 ? q1 : q0;
      var qB = yB === 1 ? q1 : q0;
      var m = qA - qB;
      var v = qA * (1 - qA) + qB * (1 - qB);
      return { mean: m, mean2: v + m * m };
    }
    var m11 = fdMoments(1, 1), m10 = fdMoments(1, 0), m01 = fdMoments(0, 1), m00 = fdMoments(0, 0);
    var meanF = p11 * m11.mean + p10 * m10.mean + p01 * m01.mean + p00 * m00.mean;
    var meanF2 = p11 * m11.mean2 + p10 * m10.mean2 + p01 * m01.mean2 + p00 * m00.mean2;
    var sigmaF2 = meanF2 - meanF * meanF;
    var covDF = (p10 * m10.mean - p01 * m01.mean) - meanD * meanF;
    if (!(sigmaD2 > 1e-12) || !(sigmaF2 > 1e-12)) {
      throw new Error("Degenerate within-pair differences; adjust the inputs.");
    }
    return { sigmaY2: sigmaD2, sigmaF2: sigmaF2, covYf: covDF };
  }

  // Difference in means, continuous outcome, equal labeled n per group.
  function updateDiffMean() {
    try {
      var delta = readNum("dm_delta");
      var sdA = readNum("dm_sd_A");
      var sdB = readNum("dm_sd_B");
      var r2A = readNum("dm_r2_A");
      var r2B = readNum("dm_r2_B");
      var NA = readNum("dm_N_A");
      var NB = readNum("dm_N_B");
      var alpha = readNum("dm_alpha");
      var targetPower = readNum("dm_power") / 100;
      var nonresponse = readNum("dm_nonresponse") / 100;

      if (!(Math.abs(delta) > 0)) {
        throw new Error("The difference in means must be nonzero.");
      }
      if (!(sdA > 0 && sdB > 0)) {
        throw new Error("Outcome SDs must be positive.");
      }
      checkR2(r2A, "R² in group A");
      checkR2(r2B, "R² in group B");
      if (!(NA > 0 && NB > 0)) {
        throw new Error("N_A and N_B must be positive.");
      }
      checkCommon(alpha, targetPower, nonresponse);
      var pilotM = readPilot("dm_pilot_n");
      var r2APoint = r2A, r2BPoint = r2B;
      if (pilotM !== null) {
        r2A = Math.pow(rhoLowerBound(Math.sqrt(r2A), pilotM, 0.9), 2);
        r2B = Math.pow(rhoLowerBound(Math.sqrt(r2B), pilotM, 0.9), 2);
      }

      var s2A = sdA * sdA, s2B = sdB * sdB;
      var ppiPower = function (n) {
        var v = varOneSample(n, NA, s2A, s2A, Math.sqrt(r2A) * s2A, "oracle") +
          varOneSample(n, NB, s2B, s2B, Math.sqrt(r2B) * s2B, "oracle");
        return powerFromVariance(delta, alpha, v);
      };
      var classicPower = function (n) {
        return powerFromVariance(delta, alpha, (s2A + s2B) / n);
      };
      var nPpi = solveNByPower(ppiPower, targetPower, 2, 10000000);
      var nClassic = solveNByPower(classicPower, targetPower, 2, 10000000);
      if (!Number.isFinite(nPpi) || !Number.isFinite(nClassic)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible under current assumptions: no finite n found.");
      }
      var dmNote = pilotM === null ? "" : pilotNote(pilotM, r2APoint, r2A).replace("R² =", "R² in group A =") +
        (r2BPoint === r2APoint ? "" : pilotNote(pilotM, r2BPoint, r2B).replace("R² =", "R² in group B ="));
      showResult("dm", nPpi, nClassic, nonresponse, "outcomes per group", dmNote);
    } catch (err) {
      clearResult("dm", err);
    }
  }

  // Paired mean difference, continuous outcome.
  function updatePaired() {
    try {
      var delta = readNum("pm_delta");
      var sdD = readNum("pm_sd_d");
      var r2D = readNum("pm_r2_d");
      var N = readNum("pm_N");
      var alpha = readNum("pm_alpha");
      var targetPower = readNum("pm_power") / 100;
      var nonresponse = readNum("pm_nonresponse") / 100;

      if (!(Math.abs(delta) > 0)) {
        throw new Error("The mean difference must be nonzero.");
      }
      if (!(sdD > 0)) {
        throw new Error("The SD of the within-pair difference must be positive.");
      }
      checkR2(r2D, "R² of the predicted differences");
      if (!(N > 0)) {
        throw new Error("The number of unlabeled pairs must be positive.");
      }
      checkCommon(alpha, targetPower, nonresponse);
      var pilotM = readPilot("pm_pilot_n");
      var r2DPoint = r2D;
      if (pilotM !== null) {
        r2D = Math.pow(rhoLowerBound(Math.sqrt(r2D), pilotM, 0.9), 2);
      }

      var s2 = sdD * sdD;
      var zAlpha = inverseNormal(1 - alpha / 2);
      var zBeta = inverseNormal(targetPower);
      var targetVar = Math.pow(delta / (zAlpha + zBeta), 2);
      var nPpi = solveNByVariance(function (n) {
        return varOneSample(n, N, s2, s2, Math.sqrt(r2D) * s2, "oracle");
      }, targetVar, 2, 10000000);
      var nClassic = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(s2 / targetVar));
      if (!Number.isFinite(nPpi)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible under current assumptions: no finite n found.");
      }
      showResult("pm", nPpi, nClassic, nonresponse, "pairs", pilotNote(pilotM, r2DPoint, r2D));
    } catch (err) {
      clearResult("pm", err);
    }
  }

  // Paired proportions with a binary classifier applied to both conditions.
  function updatePairedBinary() {
    try {
      var pA = readNum("pb_pA") / 100;
      var pB = readNum("pb_pB") / 100;
      var rho = readNum("pb_rho");
      var sens = readNum("pb_sens");
      var spec = readNum("pb_spec");
      var N = readNum("pb_N");
      var alpha = readNum("pb_alpha");
      var targetPower = readNum("pb_power") / 100;
      var nonresponse = readNum("pb_nonresponse") / 100;

      if (!(pA > 0 && pA < 1 && pB > 0 && pB < 1)) {
        throw new Error("Prevalences must be in (0%, 100%).");
      }
      if (Math.abs(pA - pB) < 1e-8) {
        throw new Error("The two prevalences must differ to define an effect.");
      }
      if (!(rho > -1 && rho < 1)) {
        throw new Error("The within-pair correlation must be in (-1, 1).");
      }
      if (!(sens >= 0 && sens <= 1 && spec >= 0 && spec <= 1)) {
        throw new Error("Sensitivity and specificity must be in [0, 1].");
      }
      if (!(N > 0)) {
        throw new Error("The number of unlabeled pairs must be positive.");
      }
      checkCommon(alpha, targetPower, nonresponse);

      var m = pairedBinaryMoments(pA, pB, rho, sens, spec);
      var delta = pA - pB;
      var zAlpha = inverseNormal(1 - alpha / 2);
      var zBeta = inverseNormal(targetPower);
      var targetVar = Math.pow(delta / (zAlpha + zBeta), 2);
      var nPpi = solveNByVariance(function (n) {
        return varOneSample(n, N, m.sigmaY2, m.sigmaF2, m.covYf, "oracle");
      }, targetVar, 2, 10000000);
      var nClassic = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(m.sigmaY2 / targetVar));
      if (!Number.isFinite(nPpi)) {
        throw new Error("Infeasible under current assumptions: no finite n found.");
      }
      showResult("pb", nPpi, nClassic, nonresponse, "pairs");
    } catch (err) {
      clearResult("pb", err);
    }
  }

  function setActivePanel(targetPanelId) {
    var tabs = document.querySelectorAll(".sscalc-tab");
    var panels = document.querySelectorAll(".sscalc-panel");
    tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
      var active = tab.getAttribute("data-panel") === targetPanelId;
      tab.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
      tab.setAttribute("aria-selected", active ? "true" : "false");
    });
    panels.forEach(function (panel) {
      panel.classList.toggle("is-active", panel.id === targetPanelId);
    });
  }

  function init() {
    document.querySelectorAll(".sscalc-tab").forEach(function (button) {
      button.addEventListener("click", function () {
        setActivePanel(button.getAttribute("data-panel"));
      });
    });

    [
      "single_outcome", "single_lambda_mode", "single_delta", "single_unlabeled_N",
      "single_alpha", "single_power", "single_prev", "single_sens", "single_spec",
      "single_nonresponse", "single_sigma_y2", "single_sigma_f2", "single_cov_yf",
      "single_nonresponse_cont", "single_pilot_n"
    ].forEach(function (field) {
      id(field).addEventListener("input", function () {
        if (field === "single_outcome") {
          updateSingleModeUI();
        }
        updateSingle();
      });
      id(field).addEventListener("change", function () {
        if (field === "single_outcome") {
          updateSingleModeUI();
        }
        updateSingle();
      });
    });

    [
      "diff_pA", "diff_pB", "diff_N_A", "diff_N_B", "diff_alpha", "diff_power",
      "diff_sens_A", "diff_spec_A", "diff_sens_B", "diff_spec_B", "diff_nonresponse_A", "diff_nonresponse_B"
    ].forEach(function (field) {
      id(field).addEventListener("input", updateDiff);
      id(field).addEventListener("change", updateDiff);
    });

    [
      ["dm", ["delta", "sd_A", "sd_B", "r2_A", "r2_B", "pilot_n", "N_A", "N_B", "alpha", "power", "nonresponse"], updateDiffMean],
      ["pm", ["delta", "sd_d", "r2_d", "pilot_n", "N", "alpha", "power", "nonresponse"], updatePaired],
      ["pb", ["pA", "pB", "rho", "sens", "spec", "N", "alpha", "power", "nonresponse"], updatePairedBinary]
    ].forEach(function (spec) {
      spec[1].forEach(function (field) {
        id(spec[0] + "_" + field).addEventListener("input", spec[2]);
        id(spec[0] + "_" + field).addEventListener("change", spec[2]);
      });
    });

    updateSingleModeUI();
    updateSingle();
    updateDiff();
    updateDiffMean();
    updatePaired();
    updatePairedBinary();
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
